project_type: React SPA (Vite + TypeScript + TanStack Query + Wouter + shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS v4 + Framer Motion)
build_system: pnpm workspaces monorepo, frontend at artifacts/resume-matcher/
test_framework: No test runner configured for frontend; relies on build + typecheck
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm --filter @workspace/resume-matcher run build from repo root. 2. Run pnpm --filter @workspace/resume-matcher run typecheck. Both must pass.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Node.js v22 + pnpm available. No test runner, only build+typecheck for validation.
contribution_requirements: Standard TypeScript + Tailwind conventions. Uses shadcn/ui new-york style with CSS variables. Tailwind v4 with @theme inline and CSS custom properties.
key_patterns: - shadcn/ui components in src/components/ui/ with CVA variants. - Pages in src/pages/. - Layout in src/components/layout.tsx with sidebar + mobile bottom nav. - CSS variables in src/index.css for theming (light/dark). - Framer Motion available but sparingly used. - Card component has variant/hover props. - Button has loading state. - Badge has size/animation variants. - DM Sans font loaded from Google Fonts (not Inter as CSS states).
directory_structure: artifacts/resume-matcher/ - Vite React app. src/pages/ has 14 page components. src/components/ has feature components + ui/ subdirectory with 50+ shadcn components. src/hooks/ has 4 hooks. src/lib/ has utils.ts and deepseek-storage.ts.
